title: Cloud Sessions List
eyebrow: Design for approval · fixes from the 0.4.0 QA, nothing built yet

short.lead: Your 0.4.0 test found four problems. The untitled sessions are already fixed. This page proposes the cloud sessions you asked for: each account's claude.ai/code sessions listed in the app beside your local ones, read the same way Claude Code's own teleport picker reads them. ("Teleport" means bringing a cloud session down to your PC.) The Android layout fix waits on a screenshot from you.
short.hint: Tap an item to see what it does and what it needs from you.
items: Claude Code 2.1.3xx writes about 90 KB of hook and skill text before your first message, and the app only read the first 64 KB. Titles now come from the prompt on line 1 and the last-prompt line. Checked on a real 6 MB transcript, with 2 new tests.
Nothing. It ships in the next build.

For each account, the app asks Anthropic's API (the web service programs use to request data) for that account's cloud sessions, using the sign-in already saved in its Claude folder, every 30 seconds. They join the list under their project, marked with a cloud icon.

items: Open or continue a cloud session
A cloud session's pane has Open on claude.ai and Continue on this PC. Continue runs claude --teleport in that account, which "teleports" the session: it copies the conversation and branch to your PC.
At phone width (390 px), the app's own screens fit with nothing off the edge, so the breakage you saw is probably specific to the installed Android app file (the APK). I need to see it to fix it.

changes: The session list reads only each account's local Claude folder.

Cloud sessions run on Anthropic's servers and are never written to that folder, so they can't appear today. The 2026-10-19 cloud design (`docs/plans/router-cloud-sessions.html`) was never approved and was drawn for the old tile grid. This page replaces it. The account list, the session list, the panes and the idea of continuing a cloud session on your PC are reused, and that page's Cloud tile is dropped.
Local and cloud sessions in one list.
Every session you have, in one place.

Claude Code's own teleport picker calls GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/code/sessions and sends the account's sign-in token, a secret string that proves you are signed in, in the headers Authorization: Bearer and anthropic-version 2023-06-01. The token sits in that account's Claude folder, in .credentials.json under claudeAiOauth. The app reads the token, never writes it, and makes the same call. Each entry gives an id, title, status (running, idle or archived), the repository, and created and last-active times. Archived sessions are hidden.

changes: What happens when an account's token has run out.

Sign-in tokens expire, and I have not measured how long they last. Claude Code renews them whenever it runs. The app never renews them itself, because writing a new token into Claude's file could sign that account out of Claude Code. When a token has expired, the account's cloud group shows 'Sign-in out of date' with a Refresh button. Refresh runs claude auth status in that account. That command is meant to renew the sign-in, but I have not tested it, so it may not work.
A clear notice and a one-tap refresh.
You're never left wondering why cloud sessions disappeared.
choices: place
Where should cloud sessions sit in the list?
A
Mixed in with local ones, by project
Grouped under their repository's name, like local sessions, with a cloud icon and the word cloud in the second line, as in the mock-up.
B
Their own Cloud group at the top
Separate from local sessions, so they're easy to find, but one project then shows in two places.
Option A keeps one place per project, which is how the list already works.
tap
What should tapping a cloud session do?
A
Show its pane with two buttons
Open on claude.ai opens it in your browser. Continue on this PC copies it here with claude --teleport.
B
Open claude.ai straight away
One tap fewer, but no way to bring the session to your PC from the app.
Option A gives you both, and the pane can show the status and repository too.
expired
When an account's sign-in has expired:
A
Show a notice and a Refresh button
Refresh runs claude auth status in that account. It is meant to renew the sign-in, but that is untested. The app never writes into Claude's files.
B
Hide that account's cloud sessions quietly
Less on screen, but sessions vanish without a reason.
Option A says what happened, in plain words, which matters more than a tidy screen.

wrapup.summary: Cloud sessions from every account join the session list, read the same way Claude Code's teleport picker reads them, and the untitled-sessions bug is fixed.
